blockers_detail.description: DemoService (/demo/run) generates synthetic procedural craters and marks them without explicit synthetic prefixes, and CorrespondenceService performs planar 2D matching rather than invoking Phase 3 3D PhysicalCandidateEngine for real pairs.
blockers_detail.remediation: Phase 8.1 must route real OHRC/TMC-2 through GroundGrid/PhysicalCandidateEngine returning FOOTPRINT_NON_OVERLAP and flag procedural demo observations explicitly as is_synthetic=True.

blockers_detail.description: Backend API (/correspondence/analyze) is decoupled from Phase 3 GroundGrid and 3D ray-traced parallax epipolar corridors (operates only on in-memory 2D arrays).
blockers_detail.remediation: Create unified PipelineController bridging Phase 3 GroundGrid/DEM with Backend Services.

blockers_detail.description: E2E_INTEGRATION_TEST_MISSING: Repository has 299 isolated unit/benchmark tests, but lacks an end-to-end integration test exercising HTTP client -> DB -> Pipeline -> Entity -> Gap -> NBO.
Frontend UI lacks dedicated tabs/views for the authoritative Phase 7.6 Real Lunar Non-Overlap Negative Control and Phase 7.9 Robustness Response Curves.
blockers_detail.remediation: Expose Phase 7 benchmark results and real-data negative control viewer in Phase 8.2.

blockers_detail.description: Docker backend attempts volume-mounting large local data, which would fail if deployed on standard cloud serverless containers without object storage/tiling.
blockers_detail.remediation: Implement scientific worker architecture and lightweight tile caching in Phase 8.3.

blockers_detail.description: README.md contains marketing phrasing ('Transforms disconnected observations... builds memory and reasoning') that needs context-bounding alongside authoritative reports.
blockers_detail.remediation: Harmonize README.md with Phase 7.12 limitations and create docs/DEMO_RUNBOOK.md.
